$comment: Machine-readable module graph for agents. Planners assign work items to modules so parallel builders never share files; reviewers use depends_on/used_by to find what a change can break; the verify step uses tests + shared_resources. Keep in sync when adding a module (see docs/AGENT_PROCESS.md). Every repo file matches exactly one module path (dirs end in /); a module owns its own test files, and tests lists what to run.

shared_resources.docker_api_image: Building/running the api image (`docker compose build api`, `docker compose run --rm api ...`). One agent at a time: parallel builds collide.
shared_resources.next_dot_dir: frontend/.next. `next build` clobbers the running dev server; only the serialized verify step may build, after stopping the dev server.
shared_resources.postgres_db: The live dev database (docker volume pgdata). Schema changes go through db._add_missing_columns (nullable columns only).
shared_resources.shared_hotspots: Files many features touch: backend/app/main.py, backend/app/models.py, backend/app/config.py, frontend/src/lib/api.ts, frontend/src/components/Nav.tsx, frontend/src/app/globals.css. At most one builder per wave may edit each; globals.css may be appended by several only under their own /* --- Section --- */ header.
shared_resources.smtp_provider: The SMTP account behind email delivery (SMTP_* env). Tests never send (FakeTransport); never point a dev or test run at a real list.

modules.summary: FastAPI routes (incl. /api/newsletter/*, /api/tickers/sitemap, /api/research/studies, /api/journal/chain|verify, /api/health/details|history; mounts the delivery router), rate-limit middleware + admin dependency wiring, lifespan, scheduler loops (slow: ingest, borrow snapshot, journal, seal_cycle, newsletter_cycle (+ email), digest_cycle, uptime_cycle; fast: EDGAR+halts poller), AppState. research_jobs.MODULES: backtest, event_study, event_study_oos, insider_study.

Settings (env) incl. AdminSettings (ADMIN_TOKEN, RESEARCH_JOBS_ENABLED, MUTATIONS_ENABLED) and rate-limit settings, engine/session, stopgap column migration, all ORM tables (incl. subscribers, email_sends).
RSS, EDGAR multi-form feeds + filing text, Alpaca news, Nasdaq halts.
Ingest cycle, fast EDGAR poll, NEW_ARTICLE_HOOKS, dedupe, ticker tagging, company sizes, signal taxonomy, LLM enrichment, SSE.

Edge Lab event study (StudyDesign/run_design, firm-clustered t, --offline replay), pre-registered out-of-sample study (oos.py, PREREGISTRATION_OOS.md), hash-only input manifests and canonical compare (snapshot.py), Yahoo price loader (raw/adjusted prices, split unadjusting).
Portfolio backtester, run log, readiness gates, IBKR borrow archiver.
Forward signal journal (track record), daily marking, live-vs-expected summary, tamper-evident daily SHA-256 hash chain (digest.py, {data_dir}/journal_chain.jsonl).
Discord alerts for signal filings and halts, alert log with detection latency.
Cash runway, share dilution, offering history (SEC XBRL), FINRA short interest.
Weekly Small-Cap Filing Radar: build, render Markdown/HTML, immutable file archive ({data_dir}/newsletters/), journal seal line (track_record.seal), CLI (python -m app.newsletter.build).

Email delivery, off unless SMTP_HOST + EMAIL_FROM + EMAIL_POSTAL_ADDRESS: double opt-in list (subscribers, email_sends), idempotent newsletter fan-out and daily digest, SMTP/Fake transports, public /api/subscribe|unsubscribe|subscription/daily|delivery/status router. Own DeliverySettings (SMTP_*, EMAIL_*).

Separate pre-registered Form 4 insider-purchase event study: SEC insider data sets, safe Form 4 XML parser, CMP routine/opportunistic classifier, writes {data_dir}/event_study_insider_purchases.json (python -m app.insiders.study). Never touches pipeline/signals.py.

Admin policy for every mutating endpoint (token > env flag > local-only) and per-client sliding-window rate limiter (security.py); deep health evaluation and uptime history in {data_dir}/uptime.jsonl (health.py). main.py wires both.

Browser API client + types (mirror backend; ApiError, admin token helpers, send() for writes), formatting helpers, nav (incl. Learn tab), footer (Subscribe/Status links, admin-error notice), layout, global styles/tokens. next.config.ts sets output: standalone. server-api.ts belongs to fe_ticker.
News feed and Signals pages.

Server-rendered SEO ticker pages ((view)/ route group, 404 gate, summary.ts), server-side fetch helpers + SITE_URL (server-api.ts, also used by the newsletter and Learn pages: getEventStudy, getBacktestReport), sitemap.xml (incl. /learn pages from lib/learn/lessons.ts), robots.txt.
Edge Lab (study selector main/oos/insider_purchases, OOS comparison + confirmatory verdicts), Backtest and Track record pages (incl. SealPanel) and their charts.
Methodology, legal drafts, server-rendered newsletter archive and issue pages (/newsletter, /newsletter/[issue]) with the SubscribeForm client island, placeholder pages.

Server-rendered Learn section: /learn index, /learn/[slug] (6 lessons, static params, ISR 1 h, live numbers via server-api), /learn/curriculum (8 weeks); client widgets/simulators with seeded PRNG (lib/learn/stats.ts, simulations.ts), lesson registry (lessons.ts), live-number helpers (live.ts). ConfirmatoryBlock/parts are also used by the Edge Lab.
/status: health components, 7-day uptime, incidents, journal seal verification, and the admin-token box (session storage, shared with ResearchRunPanel via api.ts get/setAdminToken).
Research docs, results, product research, this graph, process doc, README, and the shared guides/env examples owned by the workflow's final docs node (SHARED_DOCS in feature-graph.js).

Agent tooling and dev/deploy infra: scripts/pytest.sh (parallel-safe tests on mounted source), scripts/reproduce.sh (offline study replay + compare), Makefile shortcuts, feature-graph workflow, preview config, dev and prod compose files, api and web Dockerfiles, CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml), ignore/attributes rules, api requirements, pytest config and conftest.
